plusX.meaning: source directions rise in u/v on both panels; future triangle winding must account for opposite half orientations; not mesh orientation qualification

curveFormula: E(t)=h00(t)*P0+h01(t)*P1+h10(t)*M0+h11(t)*M1; h00=2t^3-3t^2+1,h01=-2t^3+3t^2,h10=t^3-2t^2+t,h11=t^3-t^2; M are local-parameter tangents; exact endpoint ID return at t=0/1 in a future evaluator
orientations: south/north west-to-east, west/east south-to-north. Local0..1 for each patch edge; canonical edge orientation field applied BEFORE function evaluation. Shared edge has one ID and one function, never a panel-specific jet.

backPolicy.choice: at part/back corner the common entire back trace starts toward back-1 using the endpoint secant. Its X reaches0 at back-1 with zero X derivative and stays0 afterward. Y/Z use secants of the shared back P sequence. Neither old side-specific back trace is selected or sampled/welded.
backPolicy.corner: part-4 is the same position ID for the last part edge and first back edge; distinct prescribed edge tangents are allowed. Both adjoining Coons patches meet their own identical canonical curves at that corner. No single tangent plane/C1/regularity promise; a crease or singularity is a future rejection condition.

proof.south: v=0: north term0; west(0)=P00,east(0)=P10 cancel B(u,0), leaving south(u).
proof.north: v=1: south term0; west(1)=P01,east(1)=P11 cancel B(u,1), leaving north(u).
proof.west: u=0: east term0; south(0)=P00,north(0)=P01 cancel B(0,v), leaving west(v).
proof.east: u=1: west term0; south(1)=P10,north(1)=P11 cancel B(1,v), leaving east(v).
proof.shared: same canonical edge ID and orientation-consistent t imply identical prescribed boundary function for every t, not just knots; cancellation above establishes each patch trace equals it in exact arithmetic.
proof.floatLimit: mathematical identity is not bit-exact GPU proof. Any future builder must use canonical endpoint/edge sample records byID for identical boundaries and retain finite/arithmetic tolerance checks. No choice between differing panel surfaces occurs because only one prescribed curve exists.

roles.coverage: all 40 bicubic cells form ONE explicit cranial/back/side sheet with top/back shared boundaries; no separate roof/cap and no gap between independently generated regions
roles.framing: u=0 opening curve and first circumferential band own unequal part-to-temple-to-cheek/jaw/end flow
roles.volume: u=.25,.5,.75 ridges/side/back stations own rounded cross-sections; all axes vary by station
roles.hairDetail: not supplied; later visible guide/strand material, multi-scale breakup and complete composed groom are separate qualifications

attachment.hypothesis: future single-head rigid ownership of all authored points; no mixed weights, dynamic strand or moving fit promise
attachment.headOwner: named head bone must be identical to one bone in ACTUAL figure.body.skeleton; use that skeleton own inverse bind and actual body bind matrices
attachment.futureGroupParent: figure.root, raw geometry remains unchanged; groupLocal(t)=inverse(M_figureRootWorld(t))*W(t); matrixAutoUpdate=false, update after actual rig matrices
attachment.guards: finite invertible matrices, identity exact bone/skeleton/bind ownership, complete proper rigid full transform per existing assertRigidHairTransform; refuse mismatch
attachment.observation: source-only formula; NO current matrix observation or Avatar construction in this slice. Previous frozen posed head matrix is explicitly NOT reused as rest registration. Future builder must record actual matrix operands before any native trial.

limits: No surface evaluation, mesh/Avatar/material/renderer/native/GPU/browser job; no appearance pass.
No currentmatrix operands/body-morph/moving-fit or complete hairstyle/AAA qualification.
This replaces interpolation/ownership responsibility while preserving position hypotheses; old tensor net is not repaired or rerun.
